posted_text:
🗳️ Elections & Voting Rights
NJ A5641 — NJ Limits Military & Law Enforcement Near Polling Places

New Jersey is adding restrictions to prevent active duty military and certain law enforcement officers from being within 100 feet of polling places and ballot drop boxes during elections. The bill also creates an exception for the New Jersey National Guard when they are deployed by the Governor to protect voter access. ...
